title: Workers had severe reactions to touching the craft
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Workers had severe reactions to touching the craft, about late 1980s at S4, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And apparently people had severe reactions to some of the stuff just touching the craft.

plain: Bob Lazar says he worked on alien spacecraft in the late 1980s at a secret site called S4 in the Nevada desert. Talking to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, he passes on what someone there told him: some workers had severe physical reactions just from touching the craft. If true, it would mean the craft were made of, or carried, something harmful to the human body.
